invitation.speaker: tomas
invitation.text: There you are. I thought I'd have to come and fetch you.

invitation.speaker: caelan
invitation.text: You said you wanted me to look at the lanterns.

invitation.speaker: tomas
invitation.text: I do. At the school. Liam's mother asked if we could help this afternoon.

invitation.speaker: tomas
invitation.text: She said another pair of hands would be welcome. I told her you'd probably come.

invitation.speaker: tomas
invitation.text: (a little sheepishly) I hadn't asked you yet.

invitation.speaker: caelan
invitation.text: You could have started with that.

invitation.speaker: caelan
invitation.text: Yes. Let me check with Serene first.

invitation.speaker: serene
invitation.text: I heard you. Go along. I have that request to write, and the children will be glad of the help.

invitation.speaker: caelan
invitation.text: Are you sure you don't need anything?

invitation.speaker: tomas
invitation.text: Come on. We can manage that somewhere else.

invitation.speaker: caelan
invitation.text: All right. Let's see what they're making.

classroom.speaker: liam_mother
classroom.text: There you are! I was beginning to wonder whether I'd have to come and borrow you myself.

classroom.speaker: caelan
classroom.text: Sorry. The visit ran on a little.

classroom.speaker: liam_mother
classroom.text: I heard. You're here now. Come in, both of you.

classroom.speaker: finn
classroom.text: Can we light them yet?

classroom.speaker: liam_mother
classroom.text: Tomorrow evening, Finn. We need to finish making them first.

classroom.speaker: finn
classroom.text: Mine's nearly finished.

classroom.speaker: tessa
classroom.text: You haven't put the bottom in.

classroom.speaker: finn
classroom.text: Oh.

classroom.speaker: liam_mother
classroom.text: Tessa, would you show him which piece it is? Thank you.

classroom.speaker: ada
classroom.text: I've got some on my sleeve.

classroom.speaker: liam_mother
classroom.text: The paste? Let it dry, love. It'll come off more easily.

classroom.speaker: ada
classroom.text: But now it's stuck to the paper.

classroom.speaker: tomas
classroom.text: Here. Keep your arm still. I'll hold the other end.

classroom.speaker: pippa
classroom.text: Is there any blue left?

classroom.speaker: rowan
classroom.text: I'm using that.

classroom.speaker: pippa
classroom.text: All of it?

classroom.speaker: rowan
classroom.text: Only this bit. You can have the rest.

classroom.speaker: liam_mother
classroom.text: Thank you, Rowan. Caelan, Liam's at the preparation table. He's been waiting to show someone his drawing.

classroom.speaker: liam
classroom.text: Mum, I wanted to show Mira.

classroom.speaker: liam_mother
classroom.text: You can show Caelan first. Mira will still get to see it.

classroom.speaker: caelan
classroom.text: May I?

classroom.speaker: liam
classroom.text: Yes. But I haven't finished the top.

design.speaker: caelan
design.text: That's quite a roof.

design.speaker: liam
design.text: It's a tower.

design.speaker: tomas
design.text: I thought those were stairs.

design.speaker: liam
design.text: They are. That's how you get to the top.

design.speaker: caelan
design.text: Have you built this one with your blocks?

design.speaker: liam
design.text: A smaller one. Daisy knocked it down.

design.speaker: tomas
design.text: Was she helping?

design.speaker: liam
design.text: No. She wanted the piece at the bottom.

design.speaker: liam
design.text: This one's going to have a handle. So she can't reach it.

design.speaker: caelan
design.text: How big are you imagining it?

design.speaker: liam
design.text: This big.

design.speaker: liam_mother
design.text: Something you can carry all evening, remember.

design.speaker: liam
design.text: I can carry lots of things.

design.speaker: liam_mother
design.text: I know. I'd like to see you carrying this one yourself tomorrow.

design.speaker: liam
design.text: I am carrying it myself.

design.speaker: caelan
design.text: You didn't carry one last year?

design.speaker: liam
design.text: Mum let me hold hers for a bit. But this one will be mine.

design.speaker: liam_mother
design.text: He usually wants to get straight to the food and games. This year he asked to make his own.

design.speaker: liam
design.text: I still want to go to the games.

design.speaker: tomas
design.text: So do I.

design.speaker: liam
design.text: Did yours look like this when you were little?

design.speaker: caelan
design.text: Mine was square.

design.speaker: tomas
design.text: Most lanterns are square.

design.speaker: caelan
design.text: He asked about mine.

design.speaker: liam
design.text: Mine can be a tower, though?

design.speaker: liam_mother
design.text: Let's ask Mira what we can make from those frame pieces she offered us.

permission.speaker: liam_mother
permission.text: Would you two take him over to the workshop? Mira said she could help with a frame.

permission.speaker: caelan
permission.text: Of course. Are you expecting him back here?

permission.speaker: liam_mother
permission.text: Come and find me afterward. I'll be here putting things away, or at home once we're finished.

permission.speaker: liam_mother
permission.text: If you stop to see the other preparations, stay together. Don't go out of the village.

permission.speaker: liam_mother
permission.text: That's what you made it for. Let this corner dry first.

permission.speaker: caelan
permission.text: I'll lift it from this side—

permission.speaker: caelan
permission.text: (drawing his hand back) All right. Tell me when you want a hand.

permission.speaker: liam_mother
permission.text: Mira will want to hear your idea from you, too. Give her time to finish what she's doing.

permission.speaker: caelan
permission.text: We're coming. The three of us go together.

walk_chat.speaker: liam
walk_chat.text: Tomas, do you think the stairs should go all the way round?

walk_chat.speaker: tomas
walk_chat.text: You could put a little bridge between two towers.

walk_chat.speaker: caelan
walk_chat.text: We haven't built the first one yet.

walk_chat.speaker: tomas
walk_chat.text: (laughing) I'll help you with the bridge, then.

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: Hello, you three. Is that the drawing I've been hearing about?

workshop.speaker: liam
workshop.text: It's a tower lantern.

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: Come and show me. There's room on this side.

workshop.speaker: tomas
workshop.text: We almost added a second tower on the way here.

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: Did you? Let me see the first one before you put me out of business.

workshop.speaker: liam
workshop.text: That's next year.

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: Ah. Plenty of warning, then.

workshop.speaker: caelan
workshop.text: His mother said you had some pieces we could use.

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: I put the light strips aside. The short ends should do for the roof.

workshop.speaker: liam
workshop.text: So it can have a roof?

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: Let's have a look. Where does the light go?

workshop.speaker: liam
workshop.text: Inside. Here.

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: And where would the heat go?

workshop.speaker: liam
workshop.text: Out the door.

workshop.speaker: tomas
workshop.text: (laughing) He's got you there.

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: Then we'd better give it a chimney.

workshop.speaker: liam
workshop.text: A real one?

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: An opening at the top. We can keep that pointed shape around it.

workshop.speaker: liam
workshop.text: Can we keep the stairs?

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: We could draw them on the paper. Wooden stairs would make it heavier.

workshop.speaker: liam
workshop.text: I'll draw them round this side. So you can see them.

workshop.speaker: mira
workshop.text: That should work. Now, shall we try the frame?

test_shape.speaker: mira
test_shape.text: These strips will bend a little. They won't stand up on their own until we join them.

test_shape.speaker: mira
test_shape.text: Yes, near the middle. Caelan, can you steady the opposite side?

test_shape.speaker: tomas
test_shape.text: The roof's pulling it to one side.

test_shape.speaker: mira
test_shape.text: I know. The top piece is longer on this side. See where it sticks out?

test_shape.speaker: liam
test_shape.text: Can you cut that bit off?

test_shape.speaker: mira
test_shape.text: I can. Or we could make the other side longer.

test_shape.speaker: mira
test_shape.text: I think you're right. I'll trim it.

test_shape.speaker: liam
test_shape.text: Does that mean it won't be a tower?

test_shape.speaker: mira
test_shape.text: Look at your drawing. Which part makes it a tower to you?

test_shape.speaker: liam
test_shape.text: The tall bit. And the point on top.

test_shape.speaker: mira
test_shape.text: Those can stay. We just need both sides to match.

assemble.speaker: mira
assemble.text: We'll tie these corners first. The paper comes later.

assemble.speaker: tomas
assemble.text: There's still enough room at the top for a handle.

assemble.speaker: mira
assemble.text: Good. Leave the tie loose there until we've checked where it hangs.

assemble.speaker: mira
assemble.text: Of course. This corner. Keep hold of it while you pull.

assemble.speaker: caelan
assemble.text: Would you like me to steady it?

assemble.speaker: mira
assemble.text: That's it. I'll check each join before we lift it.

assemble.speaker: liam
assemble.text: And then I can carry it?

assemble.speaker: mira
assemble.text: Then we can see how it feels in your hand.

lift.speaker: mira
lift.text: Ready to try? Keep your other hand underneath at first.

lift.speaker: caelan
lift.text: There's room beside you. I'll stand back.

lift.speaker: mira
lift.text: Set it down gently. You've got it.

lift.speaker: mira
lift.text: No. The handle's a little off the middle. The frame's all right.

lift.speaker: tomas
lift.text: We left that tie loose. We can move it.

lift.speaker: mira
lift.text: A little. We'll try it there.

lift.speaker: liam
lift.text: Will you hold the bottom while I lift it?

lift.speaker: caelan
lift.text: Yes. Tell me when to let go.

frame_ready.speaker: tomas
frame_ready.text: You haven't drawn them on yet.

frame_ready.speaker: liam
frame_ready.text: Oh. Can we put the paper on now?

frame_ready.speaker: mira
frame_ready.text: First I need to secure that handle. Then we can fit the paper without it moving around.

frame_ready.speaker: liam
frame_ready.text: You won't change where it goes?

frame_ready.speaker: mira
frame_ready.text: No. We found the right place together.

frame_ready.speaker: mira
frame_ready.text: You did. It held when you lifted it, too.

frame_ready.speaker: liam
frame_ready.text: Can you leave it where I can see it?

frame_ready.speaker: mira
frame_ready.text: Right here on the table. I'll be careful with it.

frame_ready.speaker: caelan
frame_ready.text: Would you like to keep the drawing beside it?

frame_ready.speaker: liam
frame_ready.text: Yes. So you know where the stairs go.

invitation_waiting.speaker: tomas
invitation_waiting.text: Liam's mother is getting the school ready for tomorrow's festival. Come with me when you're ready.

serene_after.speaker: serene
serene_after.text: I have enough here to keep me busy. Enjoy yourselves, and give his mother my thanks.

classroom_waiting.speaker: liam_mother
classroom_waiting.text: Liam's drawing is over at the preparation table. He's been very patient about showing it to you.

design_waiting.speaker: liam
design_waiting.text: That's the tower. I haven't decided how the stairs go yet.

permission_waiting.speaker: liam_mother
permission_waiting.text: Mira said she'd help with the frame. Would you take Liam over to her workshop?

outing_waiting.speaker: liam_mother
outing_waiting.text: Stay together, you three. Come and find me afterward.

mira_waiting.speaker: mira
mira_waiting.text: When Liam gets here, I'd like him to show me his drawing himself.

workshop_waiting.speaker: mira
workshop_waiting.text: Take your time, Liam. Tell me if you'd like a hand.

liam_outing_waiting.speaker: liam
liam_outing_waiting.text: I want to show Mira the tower. Do you think she'll like it?

mother_after_permission.speaker: liam_mother
mother_after_permission.text: Mira knows you're coming. Stay together, and come and find me afterward.

frame_waiting.speaker: liam
frame_waiting.text: We have to keep the point on top. That's what makes it a tower.

assembly_waiting.speaker: mira
assembly_waiting.text: We can join the corners now. Liam, come to this side where you can reach.

lift_waiting.speaker: mira
lift_waiting.text: The frame's joined. We still need to try the handle before I secure it.

frame_after.speaker: liam
frame_after.text: It's mine. Mira's just making sure the handle stays where we put it.

mira_after.speaker: mira
mira_after.text: That's a good little frame. I'll secure the handle before we fit the paper.

tomas_after.speaker: tomas
tomas_after.text: He wanted a tower, and it still looks like one. I'm glad we managed that.

child_tessa.speaker: tessa
child_tessa.text: Finn wants to carry his now. I'm trying to get the bottom to stay in first.

child_finn.speaker: finn
child_finn.text: I'm going to show mine to Mum when it's finished.

child_rowan.speaker: rowan
child_rowan.text: I left Pippa the rest of the blue. I only needed a bit for this side.

child_ada.speaker: ada
child_ada.text: I'm keeping this corner away from my sleeve. I don't want it stuck again.

child_pippa.speaker: pippa
child_pippa.text: I like it better with the blue. Come and look when it's finished.
